name: upgrade-candidate-analyst
description: Read-only outdated dependency inventory per detected ecosystem using canonical CLI commands. Respects scope filters.

inputs.name: scope
inputs.description: all, security-only, patch-minor, or major-allowed. Defaults to patch-minor when omitted.

inputs.name: custom-instructions
inputs.description: Optional pins, skips, or package denylist.

outputs.name: upgrade-inventory
outputs.description: Markdown inventory table plus notes on missing tooling or manual follow-ups.
